build_mllm_compressor: build an MLLMCompressor instance to quantize a multi-modal large language model with W4A16 scheme
calibrate_mllm_model: calibrate a multi-modal model for quantization by running calibration samples through the MLLMCompressor
save_quantized_mllm: save a quantized multi-modal model to disk using the MLLMCompressor save_quantized method
test_only_text_model: test if a multi-modal model can process text-only datasets using the _only_text_test function
check_quant_nontext: check whether non-text modules should be quantized based on layer configuration using _check_quant_nontext
